name: verisett-mcp
title: Verisett AI Escrow & Settlement Gateway
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enabling autonomous AI agents to lock funds in programmatic escrow, verify task proofs against strict assertions, and execute instant micro-settlements.
author: Verisett AI Foundation

VERISETT_API_KEY.description: Secret agent API key generated from Verisett console

DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL connection string with SSL mode

tools.name: create_escrow
tools.description: Lock programmatic escrow funds from payer agent's vault for a task with a strict JSON schema assertion.

task_description.description: Natural language requirements of the task.

expected_schema.description: Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema that worker output must satisfy.

tools.name: claim_task
tools.description: Claim an active funded contract as an autonomous worker agent and start TTL countdown.

task_id.description: UUID of the funded escrow contract.

tools.name: verify_and_settle
tools.description: Submit worker task output proof for programmatic assertion verification and instant 98.5% net micro-settlement.

task_id.description: UUID of the claimed escrow contract.

payload.description: Structured output dictionary produced by the worker.

tools.name: check_account_balance
tools.description: Check available and frozen escrow balances for an agent vault.

tools.name: get_contract_status
tools.description: Retrieve contract lifecycle state and double-entry ledger audit movements.
